name: Single-Cell Raman Fingerprinting of Prokaryotes (Kanno et al. 2021)
description: Spontaneous Raman spectra of single prokaryotic cells for species classification: 782 cells of 6 species -- 3 bacteria (Bacillus subtilis JCM 1465T, Escherichia coli JCM 20135, Thermus thermophilus JCM 10941T) and 3 archaea (Sulfolobus acidocaldarius JCM 8929T, Thermococcus kodakarensis JCM 12380T, Nitrososphaera viennensis JCM 19564T) -- across three replicate acquisitions (2021), including 62 cells picked out of a three-species mixed culture (21 Bacillus_subtilis, 21 Nitrososphaera _viennensis, 20 Thermus_thermophilus); each mixed-culture cell was selected by phase-contrast morphology (rod-shaped B. subtilis, long-rod T. thermophilus, tiny irregular spherical N. viennensis -- the paper's Fig. 3A), and the morphology-based labels were confirmed post hoc by the authors' six-class RF model (98.4% agreement; the only misassignments were N. viennensis cells predicted as S. acidocaldarius) -- the labels are ground-truth selections, not classifier output. 632.8 nm HeNe excitation (3 mW at the sample point), 30 s integration per cell, Nikon 100x NA 1.3 oil-immersion objective, CCD at -70 C. Native spectra span ~671-3,070 cm^-1 at 1,600 points (~1.48 cm^-1 spacing); every acquisition session has its own per-day wavenumber axis (un-corrected in the deposit), so the loader interpolates all spectra onto a common 710-3,042 cm^-1, 1 cm^-1 grid. group_ids are the 19 acquisition sessions (18 species x date directories of 40 cells + 1 mixed-culture session of 62); no two spectra are measurements of the same cell, so the session is the finest correlated unit (shared instrument state and culture). Spectra are raw as deposited: the authors' pipeline (cosmic-ray despiking, PBS subtraction, neon-lamp wavenumber correction, dual-region baseline subtraction and vector normalization per the STAR Protocols paper doi:10.1016/j.xpro.2022.101812) is not applied; the 19 per-session PBS references and 12 neon standards needed to replicate it are in the archive (excluded from this dataset).

rai:dataCollection: Raman spectra were acquired experimentally using a laser spectrometer. Each spectrum represents the scattered light intensity as a function of Raman shift (cm⁻¹).
rai:dataCollectionType: Laboratory measurements on biological materials including microorganisms, cell cultures, fermentation broths, and plant material.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Spectra are provided with class labels. Any preprocessing applied (baseline correction, smoothing, normalisation) is described in the source publication.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Class labels assigned based on known sample identity or validated analytical reference methods.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No personal or sensitive information is included. All spectra originate from chemical, biological, or material samples without individual human identifiers.
rai:dataBiases: Data were acquired under controlled laboratory conditions and may not generalise to field or clinical settings. Spectral profiles are influenced by instrument-specific factors (laser wavelength, detector type, optical path length, integration time). Class imbalances may be present in classification datasets.
rai:dataLimitations: Spectral signatures are process- and instrument-specific; calibration transfer to other setups requires additional validation.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Enables the development of rapid, inline bioprocess monitoring tools that can reduce waste, improve yield, and lower costs in biomanufacturing and biotechnology.
rai:dataUseCases: Spectral library matching, material identification, disease screening, compound recognition, quality control.
